title: Versioned policy: rules that decide, and decisions that survive
note: The policy layer is what makes 'which rules allowed this' answerable. Each mutation here removes one property that answer depends on: deny-overrides, the default-deny fallthrough, conjunctive matching, gap-free versioning, non-retroactivity, and the refusal to publish a document whose content does not match its claimed digest. P4 is the sharpest -- if in_force_at returns today's policy, every historical decision is re-judged under rules that did not exist when it was made, and I5 means nothing.

mutations.name: P1_deny_does_not_override
mutations.find: denies = [r for r in matched if r.effect is Effect.DENY]
mutations.rationale: a prohibition is defeated by any earlier broad grant; carve-outs stop carving

mutations.name: P2_no_match_falls_open
mutations.rationale: the default becomes allow; a policy that matches nothing permits everything

mutations.name: P3_matching_is_disjunctive
mutations.find:
return (_hit(self.actions, req.action)
                and _hit(self.subjects, req.subject)
                and _hit(self.roles, req.role)
                and _hit(self.resources, req.resource))
mutations.replace:
return (_hit(self.actions, req.action)
                or _hit(self.subjects, req.subject)
                or _hit(self.roles, req.role)
                or _hit(self.resources, req.resource))
mutations.rationale: a rule about one actor applies to every action, role and resource

mutations.name: P4_policy_becomes_retroactive
mutations.find: candidates = [d for seq, d in history if seq <= at_seq]
mutations.replace: candidates = [d for seq, d in history]
mutations.rationale: a historical decision is re-judged under rules written after it; I5 collapses

mutations.name: P5_version_gaps_accepted
mutations.rationale: a version can be skipped or backdated, so 'which policy governed seq N' becomes ambiguous

mutations.name: P6_publish_version_not_checked
mutations.rationale: a version can be republished with different content under the same number

mutations.name: P7_document_digest_not_verified
mutations.rationale: a rewritten policy document passes as the one whose digest was cited

mutations.name: P8_empty_match_field_means_any
mutations.rationale: a truncated DENY rule silently stops prohibiting

mutations.name: P9_bare_string_match_accepted
mutations.rationale: actions="act" becomes the character set {a,c,t} and matches nothing the author meant

mutations.name: P10_unknown_rule_fields_ignored
mutations.rationale: a rule carrying a condition this reader cannot evaluate is applied as a broader rule than written

mutations.name: P11_duplicate_rule_ids_allowed
mutations.rationale: a decision naming a rule no longer identifies which rule decided

mutations.name: P12_denial_not_raised
mutations.rationale: raise_if_denied stops refusing; every caller that relies on it fails open

mutations.name: P13_decisions_not_recorded
mutations.rationale: the recorded decision stops carrying what was decided, so an auditor reading the log learns only that something happened

mutations.name: P14_empty_rule_set_published
mutations.rationale: a document that lost its rules in serialization is published as a policy that denies everything
